questions.stem: What is the purpose of limestone in the blast furnace?

options.text: It acts as the reducing agent for iron ore
It provides extra carbon for the reaction
It removes impurities such as sand (silicon dioxide) as slag
It lowers the melting point of the iron

questions.explanation: Limestone (CaCO₃) decomposes to form calcium oxide (CaO), which reacts with sand (SiO₂) impurities to form calcium silicate (CaSiO₃), known as slag. The slag floats on the molten iron and can be tapped off separately.
